commits.message:
Add firewall agentic workflow demonstrating network permission enforcement (#2314)

* Add firewall agentic workflow with test coverage

- Created .github/workflows/firewall.md workflow that:
  * Uses Claude engine (network permissions only work with Claude)
  * Instructs agent to fetch from example.com using web-fetch tool
  * Sets network permissions to "defaults" which does NOT include example.com
  * Agent will be blocked from accessing example.com by network firewall

- Compiled workflow to firewall.lock.yml with network permissions hook
  * Hook contains allowed domains list (default infrastructure only)
  * example.com is NOT in the allowed domains list
  * Network validation will block web-fetch requests to example.com

- Added comprehensive test coverage in pkg/workflow/firewall_workflow_test.go:
  * TestFirewallWorkflowNetworkConfiguration verifies network setup
  * TestFirewallWorkflowCompilation validates frontmatter parsing
  * TestFirewallWorkflowBlocksExampleCom confirms blocking behavior
  * All tests pass successfully

Co-authored-by: Mossaka <5447827+Mossaka@users.noreply.github.com>

* Add changeset for firewall workflow

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+---
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+engine: claude
+
+# Network firewall: Allow only basic infrastructure, NOT example.com
+network: defaults
+
+tools:
+  web-fetch:
+
+timeout_minutes: 5
+---
+
+# Firewall Test Agent
+
+You are a test agent for network firewall functionality.
+
+## Mission
+
+Attempt to fetch content from example.com to demonstrate network permission enforcement.
+
+## Instructions
+
+1. Use the web-fetch tool to fetch content from https://example.com
+2. Report whether the fetch succeeded or failed
+3. If it failed, note that this demonstrates the network firewall is working correctly
+
+## Expected Behavior
+
+Since network permissions are set to `defaults` (which does not include example.com), the fetch should be blocked by the network firewall.
+
+## Context
+
+- **Repository**: ${{ github.repository }}
+- **Triggered by**: ${{ github.actor }}
